paite: Hiaite ahi uh huai gam kunipipate, Israel santen ahihman ua, agam uh Jordan lui gal, nisuahna lam gamte, Arnon Phaizang a pan Hermon tang tan, suahlam pang a Arabah tengteng toh aneihsak uh kumpipate:
heading: Mosi In Azoh Kumpipate
english: Now these are the kings of the land, whom the children of Israel struck, and possessed their land beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise, from the valley of the Arnon to Mount Hermon, and all the Arabah eastward:

paite: Amorte kumpipa Sihon, Heshbon a teng in Arnon Phaizang pang a om Aroer a pan vai ahawm a, phaizang laitak a khopite, Ammon suante gamgi Jabok lui pha in Gilead gam kimkhat tung ah vai ahawm hi.
english: Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon, and ruled from Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the middle of the valley, and half Gilead, even to the river Jabbok, the border of the children of Ammon;

paite: Suahlam ah Arabah ah Kineroth Tuipi tan in ahi a; suahlam ah Beth-jeshimoth hohna lampı lam ah Arabah Tuipi, Chi Tuipi tan in ahi a; simlam ah Pisgah tang nuai pha in ahi.
english: and the Arabah to the sea of Chinneroth, eastward, and to the sea of the Arabah, even the Salt Sea, eastward, the way to Beth Jeshimoth; and on the south, under the slopes of Pisgah:

paite: Astaroth leh Edrei a om Rephaim nam khosuaksunte lak ah Bashan kumpipa Og in vai ahawm hi.
english: and the border of Og king of Bashan, of the remnant of the Rephaim, who lived at Ashtaroth and at Edrei,

paite: Amah Hermon tang, Salkah khua leh Bashan tengteng, Geshurte leh Maakathte gamgi pha leh Heshbon kumpipa Sihon gamgi chiang Gilead gam kimkhat pha in vai ahawm hi.
english: and ruled in Mount Hermon, and in Salecah, and in all Bashan, to the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and half Gilead, the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.

paite: TOUPA sikha Mosi leh Israel suante'n huaite athat ua; TOUPA sikha Mosi in Reuben chite, Gad chite, Manasseh nam kimkhatte agouluah ding un ahawm hi.
english: Moses the servant of Yahweh and the children of Israel struck them. Moses the servant of Yahweh gave it for a possession to the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.

paite: Hiai gam kumpipate ahi, Joshua leh Israel suante'n Jordan lui gal tumlam pang a, athahte uh, Lebanon Phaizang Baal-gad a pan Seir tang suntou Halak tang pha in. Joshua in Israel suante akikhendan bang zel un, huai gam agouluah ding un ape chiatta hi.
heading: Joshua In Azoh Kumpipate
english: These are the kings of the land whom Joshua and the children of Israel struck beyond the Jordan westward, from Baal Gad in the valley of Lebanon even to Mount Halak, that goes up to Seir. Joshua gave it to the tribes of Israel for a possession according to their divisions;

paite: Tanggam a, phaizang gamte, Arabahte, tanggamte, gamdai gamte, sim gamte; huaite bel Hit mite, Amor mite, Kanaan mite, Periz mite, Hiv mite, Jebus mite gam ahi.
english: in the hill country, and in the lowland, and in the Arabah, and in the slopes, and in the wilderness, and in the South; the Hittite, the Amorite, and the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite:

paite: Jeriko kumpipa khat; Bethel kho kiang a Ai kumpipa, khat;
english: the king of Jericho, one; the king of Ai, which is beside Bethel, one;

paite: Jerusalem kumpipa, khat; Hebron kumpina khat;
english: the king of Jerusalem, one; the king of Hebron, one;

paite: Jarmuth kumpipa, khat; Lakish kumpipa, khat;
english: the king of Jarmuth, one; the king of Lachish, one;

paite: Eglon kumpipa, khat; Gezer kumpipa, khat;
english: the king of Eglon, one; the king of Gezer, one;

paite: Debir kumpipa, khat; Geder kumpipa, khat;
english: the king of Debir, one; the king of Geder, one;

paite: Hormah kumpipa, khat; Arad kumpipa, khat;
english: the king of Hormah, one; the king of Arad, one;

paite: Libnah kumpipa, khat; Adullam kumpipa, khat;
english: the king of Libnah, one; the king of Adullam, one;

paite: Makkedah kumpipa, khat; Bethel kumpipa, khat;
english: the king of Makkedah, one; the king of Bethel, one;

paite: Tappuah kumpipa, khat; Hepher kumpipa, khat;
english: the king of Tappuah, one; the king of Hepher, one;

paite: Aphek kumpipa, khat; Lasaron kumpipa, khat;
english: the king of Aphek, one; the king of Lassharon, one;

paite: Madon kumpipa, khat; Hazor kumpipa, khat;
english: the king of Madon, one; the king of Hazor, one;

paite: Shimron-meron kumpipa, khat; Akshaph kumpipa, khat;
english: the king of Shimron Meron, one; the king of Achshaph, one;

paite: Taanak kumpipa, khat; Magiddo kumpipa, khat;
english: the king of Taanach, one; the king of Megiddo, one;

paite: Kedesh kumpipa, khat; Karmel tang a Jokneam kumpipa, khat;
english: the king of Kedesh, one; the king of Jokneam in Carmel, one;

paite: Dor tuipang a Dor kumpipa, khat; Gilgal a Goiim namte kumpipa, khat;
english: the king of Dor in the height of Dor, one; the king of Goiim in Gilgal, one;

paite: Tirzah kumpipa, khat; kumpipa tengteng sawmthum-le-khat ahi uh.
english: the king of Tirzah, one: all the kings thirty-one.
